prompt: What is the purpose of the new arrangement?

options.text: To prevent incoming and outgoing trucks from obstructing one another.
options.zh: 避免進出貨車輛互相阻塞。
options.whyZh: 公告說 keep incoming and outgoing shipments from blocking each other，重點是分流以減少互相干擾。
電子零件仍收貨，只是改用四號區。
司機仍必須透過物流入口網站預約時段。

options.text: To move the warehouse to another city.
options.zh: 把倉庫搬到另一個城市。
options.whyZh: 變更的是裝卸區用途，沒有搬遷。

explanationZh: 公告說 keep incoming and outgoing shipments from blocking each other，重點是分流以減少互相干擾。
evidence: keep incoming and outgoing shipments from blocking each other.

vocabulary.note: 分別指送入場內與自場內送出的貨物。
